title: API Response Codes and Error Messages

blocks.text: The API returns following HTTP status codes:

table: Successful and a new resource is created
Request accepted. The request has been received, but not completed yet.

Forbidden This code is returned for one of the following reasons: Your service provider disabled tThe API key. The user's role has no access permissions. A required SKU subscription is missing. Contact Zscaler Support or your Zscaler Account team for assistance.

Conflict Requests could not be processed because a possible edit conflict occurred. Another admin might be saving a configuration change at the same time. The client should retry after a short time period.
